'''Rauhamaa''' is the capital of [[Imperial Suomi]].

Old source material associates the earliest framework of the Suomi state with Rauhamaa, describing early huts and a small keep near the later government district. This draft treats that as a local memory of state formation rather than a precise archaeological chronology.

== Political Role ==

Rauhamaa became the symbolic center of the [[House of Jarvinen]] and later of Suomi's constitutional monarchy. The source places the modern presidential or governmental palace near the preserved early-state site, implying that Suomi deliberately tied modern institutions to the older royal foundation.

== Open Canon ==

Rauhamaa needs a fuller city article before publication, especially for its geography, administrative districts, and role in the 1850 and 1958 constitutional changes.
